import sys, time, json, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import t_perf2
from common import validate
import planning

# realistic variant: costs from a small range, capacities 1..4, shared groups
def build_realistic(seed,nreq=500,noffer=1000,pairs=30000,cost_range=50):
    import random
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    job=t_perf2.build(seed,nreq=nreq,noffer=noffer,pairs=pairs,distinct_cost=False)
    for o in job['offers']:
        o['cost']=rng.randint(0,cost_range)
        o['capacity']=rng.randint(1,4)
    return job

for nreq,noffer,pairs,cr in ((500,1000,30000,50),(1000,2000,65000,100),(2000,4000,130000,200)):
    job=build_realistic(11,nreq=nreq,noffer=noffer,pairs=pairs,cost_range=cr)
    ctx=validate(job)
    t=time.time(); res=planning.solve(ctx,{r['id']:True for r in job['requests']})
    print(f'n={nreq} offers={noffer} pairs={pairs} cost_range={cr}: {time.time()-t:.1f}s '
          f'resolved={res["resolved"]} cost={res["cost"]}',flush=True)
PYEOF
